# DAC Starter Copilot Instructions

## Workspace commands

Use pnpm 12 (`packageManager` is pinned in the root manifest).

```sh
pnpm dev                 # Caddy + backend watcher + Vite dev server
pnpm dev:frontend        # Vite only
pnpm dev:backend         # Hono backend only
pnpm build               # Clean outputs, build both packages, and copy the frontend into backend/dist/dist
pnpm build:frontend
pnpm build:backend
pnpm lint                # ESLint across the workspace
pnpm lint -- frontend/src/pages/index.vue
pnpm lint -- backend/src/core/handlers.ts
```

There is currently no test runner or test suite, so no single-test command exists. Use the narrow ESLint commands above for changed files and `pnpm build` for cross-package validation.

## Architecture

- This is a pnpm workspace with `frontend` and `backend` packages. The frontend is Vue 3 + Vite; the backend is a Hono server on port 8080 using `better-sqlite3`.
- During development, `Caddyfile` exposes `dac.localhost`: `/api/*` proxies to the backend and every other request proxies to Vite. In preview/production, Caddy proxies all traffic to the backend, which serves the compiled SPA fallback.
- The root build runs each package build, then `utils/copydist.js` copies `frontend/dist` to `backend/dist/dist`. The backend catch-all static route depends on that exact output location (`backend/src/core/router.ts`).
- Backend startup in `backend/src/server.ts` loads configuration, initializes the SQLite cache database, registers logging/routes/middleware, and closes the database on termination. Keep HTTP handlers in `backend/src/core/handlers.ts`, route registration in `core/router.ts`, and persistence operations in `core/database.ts`.
- The cache API is under `/api/kv`: `GET /api/kv/:key`, `GET|PUT|DELETE /api/kv`, and `DELETE /api/kv/:key`; `GET /api/health` is the health endpoint. Cache rows expire by default after five minutes unless the request supplies `ttl`.

## Repository conventions

- Backend source is ESM TypeScript. Use `.js` extensions for local imports from `.ts` files, matching the existing Node/bundler resolution pattern.
- `Config` starts with defaults and is populated from process environment plus a `.env` file read from the backend process working directory. Use `BEARER_TOKEN` and `DB_PATH`; preserve environment-variable precedence over `.env` values.
- SQLite uses WAL mode and parameterized prepared statements. Preserve the `cache(key, value, expireTime)` schema and add database access through the exported functions in `core/database.ts`, not from route handlers.
- Frontend routes are filesystem-generated by `unplugin-vue-router` from `frontend/src/pages`. Do not hand-edit `frontend/route-map.d.ts`; Vite regenerates it.
- Vue, Vue Router, components, and `icon-*` components are auto-imported/generated. Keep `frontend/auto-imports.d.ts` and `frontend/components.d.ts` as generated declarations rather than manually maintaining imports there. Use `~` for the `frontend/src` alias and import UnoCSS through the existing `virtual:uno.css` entry in `src/main.ts`.
- ESLint uses `@antfu/eslint-config` with TypeScript, Vue, and UnoCSS support. Its repository-specific rules use Stroustrup braces, and permits `console`.
